text: Infectious Laryngo-Tracheitis (ILT) is caused by a virus that spreads easily through the air. Symptoms: watery eyes are usually the first sign; affected birds stay quiet due to breathing difficulty; coughing, sneezing, and head-shaking follow as birds try to dislodge exudate plugs in the trachea, stretching the head/neck to breathe; blood-tinged exudate is expelled from the trachea, and many birds die from tracheal blockage/suffocation. Treatment: antibiotics to prevent secondary bacterial infection; unusually for a viral disease, vaccinating the flock at the start of an outbreak is recommended even as a treatment measure (not just prevention).
